grammar: T_{j<-i}(omega): source layer i -> receiver layer j transfer operator; inbound and outbound records are separate.
bounded_negligible_rule: Forbidden while external_citations_attached=false. Requires a measured co-located background comparator, a source-path-interface-receiver chain and a closed power budget. None is attached, so no record uses this status; conservation-bounded non-attribution is used instead.
no_direct_cosmic_jump_rule: No pyramid-local mode is connected directly to a planetary or cosmic mode. Every intervening carrier, interface and receiver must be represented or the omitted path must be conservation-bounded; otherwise the record is a non-bridge.

natural_background_comparator.description: Synthetic placeholder comparator; NOT a measured ambient spectrum and NOT a negligibility proof.
natural_background_comparator.rule: No inbound feature may be interpreted as a Giza-related signal until it exceeds a measured co-located background comparator over the same band and time window.

conservation_bound_rule.equation: For a passive system at harmonic steady state: P_in = P_material_dissipation + P_export; P_export <= P_in.
conservation_bound_rule.bound_for_unmodelled_channels: P_any_outbound_channel <= P_export <= P_in <= P_source_assumed; if P_source is not measurable the channel is not_evaluable_missing_data, not a claim of detection and not bounded_negligible.
